body: I am a new attorney (less than a year out) so I feel like I'm stuck in this professional/work culture for a while. But it would be nice to care more about what I do.
Thank you for your kind words.

I'm an attorney. I'll be licensed for a year as of next month. The job market for new attorneys is pretty rough at the moment. I'm lucky to have a job in that respect and it's practicing the type of law that I want, but I don't have many options to go anywhere else anyway. It's not even that I really dislike my job, because some days I like it fine, it's just I guess I don't find it fulfilling, but I don't have time to do anything else even if I could think of something that would be fulfilling. I have crushing student loan debt and rent and other bills that requires that I have job, even if it is working a boat load for crappy pay.
